result.description: Compact retractable flash drive designed for everyday document transfer, school projects, and portable media backups. The anodized aluminum shell resists minor bumps and keeps the connector protected when not in use. It uses a standard USB 2.0 interface for broad compatibility with laptops, desktops, and media players. Includes a small loop for keyring attachment and comes formatted for quick plug-and-play use.
